scripts.build: bun run build:app && bun run build:packages && bun run build:native
scripts.build:app: bun build packages/app/src/index.tsx --target=browser --minify --outfile=packages/app/dist/preview.js && cp packages/app/src/preview.html packages/app/dist/preview.html
scripts.build:native: swift build --package-path native/SimViewCore -c release && cp native/SimViewCore/.build/release/simview-core packages/core/bin/simview-core
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && swift test --package-path native/SimViewCore
